The '''Bitrose sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], bordering the [[Gaulus sector/Legends|Gaulus]], [[Hunnoverrs sector/Legends|Hunnoverrs]] and [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sectors]], as well as the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It contained the planets [[Roost (planet)|Roost]] and [[Stoga]]. The planet [[Naos III/Legends|Naos III]] was located near this [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within Wild Space.

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the sector was terrorized by insane [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Danaan Kerr]].
